message: 恐怖！　集団幻聴！
KiraFes is finally tomorrow!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyuu... Paperwork, paperwork, paperwork, my head is spinning...」
Even your wings are popping out.

name: Synn
message: 「Why don't you take a little break?」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose it can't be helped. It'd be a problem if you collapsed on us.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... You could just say you're worried, you know. Hisa's just like a porcupine.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shut up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Considering your wings are sticking out and all. Better not push yourself」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Wings!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a clueless broad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sorry, Lolo-chan. Guess I'm tired too, just saw things」

name: Ria
message: 「There aren't any wings. Nope. None at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, nope, not anywhere.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Impossible, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, please don't make mistakes just because you're tired.」

name: Sally
message: 「Your wings are out again! Clumsy!」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? What's wrong, everyone? Look, there are wings right he--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like we really are tired! I just heard things!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmph, mmph!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wasn't hearing things! I heard it too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. I heard it too. So this is that rumored mass auditory hallucination.」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmph, mmph...!」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh, that! Of course I know about mass auditory hallucinations!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah. I'd heard about them before, but that was my first time experiencing one. Let's take a little break, okay?」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmph...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, so that's all it was. Of course. There's no way I'd have wings or anything, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Squeak... *thud*」
Nanaka and I gently laid the limp Sally down on the sofa.
Rest in peace.

name: Synn
message: 「Was it like this last year too?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... Maybe it's busier than last year?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it 'cause there are more stalls this time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ohh, I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Those who do not work shall not eat, so it's a good thing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though I'm going to eat without working anyway!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not something to puff your chest out about.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, do you think Sally's gonna be okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, she is a demon, so...」

name: Ria
message: 「R-Right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, y'know, this really reminds me of New Year's Eve.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why New Year's Eve?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My family runs a soba shop, right? So because of Toshikoshi soba.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, right, for a soba shop it would be.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, anyway, that makes me a hard-working girl.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you sure about thaaat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I said it's true!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka helps out at her family's place a lot, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really can't judge a book by its cover, can you~」

name: Sally
message: 「That's right!」

name: Misa
message: 「You recover fast」

name: Sally
message: 「People misunderstand me all the time just 'cause I fly around. Calling me some airheaded slacker!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's the truth, isn't it」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that?! Even though I'm busting my butt helping the student council!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never seen you actually working, though」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to put it so bluntly\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's that saying: a talentless hawk paints its talons with nail polish」

name: Ria
message: 「In so many ways... your phrasing is completely falling apart」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, I somehow get what she means」

name: Sally
message: 「I really am misunderstood!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nah, I think we understand you pretty darn well」

name: Sally
message: 「You guys are so mean!」

name: Misa
message: 「She took off...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, she's not working after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we get back to work soon」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, let's do this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yeah, let's」
